event: She pays two copper for a pallet in the Brook and Barrel's common room and sleeps the night through.

changes.note: Two copper for a pallet in the inn's common room

memory.fact: On day 9's night Nala paid 2 copper for a pallet in the Brook and Barrel's common room.
On day 9's night Nala paid 2 copper for a pallet in the Brook and Barrel's common room.
At the inn a pallet in the common room is 2 copper a night; a small room upstairs is 5.

event: At first light the five of them walk down to Tull's ford.

memory.fact: At dawn of day 10 Nala and the Four set an ambush at the sheep wall by Tull's ford.
At dawn of day 10 Nala and the Four set an ambush at the sheep wall by Tull's ford.

event: The ford runs knee-deep, ten paces wide, thirty paces out from the trees.

memory.fact: Tull's ford is knee-deep and some ten paces wide, with a drystone sheep wall along the meadow bank.
Tull's ford is knee-deep and some ten paces wide, with a drystone sheep wall along the meadow bank.

event: A drystone sheep wall runs along the meadow bank. Merrit pats it. "Here. They bunch in the water."

memory.fact: Merrit chose Tull's sheep wall for the ambush, since goblins bunch up crossing the ford's water.
Merrit chose Tull's sheep wall for the ambush, since goblins bunch up crossing the ford's water.
Folk crouched behind the sheep wall by Tull's ford cannot be seen from the treeline.

event: Dace sets them along the wall. "Bring them out to us, and don't get caught doing it."

memory.fact: Dace set the Four along the wall and bade Nala bring the goblins out to them, uncaught.
Dace set the Four along the wall and bade Nala bring the goblins out to them, uncaught.
At the ford Dace means Merrit to fire into goblins bunched midstream, then all rise from the wall.

event: Nala crosses alone and goes up the deer trail, off it among the bushes, slow and quiet.

memory.fact: On day 10 Nala crept alone up the deer trail, off it in the brush, her sense spread in pulses.
On day 10 Nala crept alone up the deer trail, off it in the brush, her sense spread in pulses.

event: Every little while she lets her sense spread wide.

changes.note: Her sense spread in pulses on the creep up the trail
Earnest use of her sense carries toward LV 6

event: A mile and more in, her sense brushes something: two bodies, forty paces ahead, coming down.

memory.fact: Near 08:45, some 1.7 miles in, her sense found two silent goblins coming down, forty paces ahead.
Near 08:45, some 1.7 miles in, her sense found two silent goblins coming down, forty paces ahead.

event: Goblins, small and silent, slipping from tree to tree beside the trail. Neither turns her way.

memory.fact: Two goblin scouts go some fifty paces ahead of the hunters; the hobgoblin walks in the middle.

event: Behind them, out past her reach, comes a low muttering, many voices. A heavy tread among them.

memory.fact: Beyond those two she heard many goblins muttering up the trail, and one heavy tread.
Beyond those two she heard many goblins muttering up the trail, and one heavy tread.
Grakk's hunters on day 10: the hobgoblin and eleven goblins LV 3 to 6, three with slings.
